description.value: Sushi Ichi is a Japanese restaurant on the East Island Highway in Parksville serving sushi rolls, tempura, katsu, gyoza, sashimi, and other traditional Japanese dishes made with fresh ingredients. The cozy wood-accented dining room accommodates both intimate dinners and larger group gatherings, and the restaurant has built a loyal local following for attentive service and artful dish presentation. Takeout and catering options are available for cyclists who prefer to eat on the go or at a destination.

address.value: 541 E Island Hwy E, Parksville, BC V9P 1V2
